lesson: For kernels without polar terms the backward-heat member is a pointwise Gaussian multiple, so the HEAT column of any polynomial functional is fixed by zeta's own values: F_tau = sum a_j exp(tau S_j/4) M_j. A finite-node inequality with positive margin passes all small |tau|; only a threshold tuned inside zeta's margin rejects a registered HEAT class. Screening summaries must list "coefficients alone" as a kind of separation. All six round-15 lanes already had one independent referee; for lanes 2, 4, 5 my pass was not blind to it.
